key.name: device
key.description: What is recorded: "" the default output's sound, "microphone" the default input, a PipeWire output's node name followed by ".monitor" for its sound, or an input's node name.

key.name: listen-seconds
key.description: How many seconds are recorded for each recognition.

key.name: notify
key.description: Show each result in a notification.

key.name: no-duplicates
key.description: A song found again moves to the top of the history instead of being added twice.

key.name: click-action
key.description: "open" opens its Shazam page, "search" opens the search link with its title and artist, "copy" copies its title and artist.

key.name: search-url
key.description: The address the "search" click action opens, followed by the song's title and artist.

key.name: history-size
key.description: How many recognized songs the history keeps.

key.name: history
key.description: Recognized songs, newest first: key, title, artist, cover, url and time (Unix seconds).
